extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: offshore speedboat (go-fast racing boat) with twin outboards, approx. 8.8 x 2.4 x 1.85 m (L incl. motors x W x H)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0 with both outboards trimmed slightly up so the skegs clear the ground, add your own water (waterline at 0.36 m: white boot stripe above the antifouling); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: speedboat_propeller_l/_r (spin around the propeller shafts), speedboat_steering_wheel (turns around its column); opaque tinted windshield; no brand, no text, no race number

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
